# AI Job Hunter

> A local-first, AI-native desktop app that finds jobs across 24 boards, tailors your resume and cover letter to each one, and does everything except hit submit. Free for personal use, source-available, no accounts, no tracking. Built by one unemployed engineer — the site is also, openly, a job application.

- Tauri 2 shell, React renderer, Rust backend, pnpm monorepo. Ships for macOS, Windows and Linux; unsigned.
- Everything runs on your machine: resume, job data and API keys never leave it. You bring your own AI provider key (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Ollama and others).
- Sourcing is 24 job boards — direct scrapers plus the Adzuna and JSearch aggregators — with a Chrome/Firefox extension for one-click job import and form autofill.
- Exports are ATS-safe PDF and DOCX from a single document model, rendered through Typst.

## Pages

- [Home](https://aijobhunter.app/): What the app does, board coverage, and the pitch. Start here.
- [How It Works](https://aijobhunter.app/how-it-works): The end-to-end flow — find a job, analyse it, tailor the resume, generate the cover letter, apply.
- [Download](https://aijobhunter.app/download): Installers per OS, current version, and the unsigned-binary caveats.
- [Privacy](https://aijobhunter.app/privacy): How the desktop app and the browser extension handle data. No accounts, no behavioural analytics; the desktop app sends opt-out crash reports, the extension sends nothing.
- [Accessibility Statement](https://aijobhunter.app/accessibility): WCAG 2.2 AA conformance status for the site, desktop app and extension — partially conformant, with known barriers listed.
- [Architecture Map](https://aijobhunter.app/architecture-map): Interactive map of the codebase — renderer, service hooks, prompts, IPC contracts, Rust commands, scraper and provider registries. Every node points at real source; a drift checker fails CI if it lies.
- [The Agent Fleet](https://aijobhunter.app/agent-system): How the repo's `.claude/` agent system works — paired author and critic per domain, routed by area, reviewed independently.
- [Technology Radar](https://aijobhunter.app/tech-radar): Adopt/Trial/Assess/Hold radar of the real stack, with the reasoning behind each choice and links to the ADR where one exists. A CI check fails the build if an entry names a dependency that no longer exists.

## Optional

- [Fly Through The World](https://aijobhunter.app/world): A scroll-driven papercraft diorama of one bad job hunt. Visual, no new facts.
- [The Creature](https://aijobhunter.app/creature): A hand-drawn ~2:40 short film about a doodle engineer who summons a tiny recruiter creature. Visual, no new facts.
